title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Lemon & Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Lemon and Lime pairs sharp Lemon with smooth, sweet Lime for a lively citrus taste that stays bright and refreshing. The balance of tang and sweetness keeps the profile clear and easy to enjoy. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this pod and refill format offers a mess-free way to enjoy reliable flavour with no top-ups or coil swaps. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and two 10ml auto-refilling containers that can provide up to 25,000 puffs of smooth MTL vapour, depending on personal vaping style. The mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt work together to deliver consistent flavour and quick nicotine satisfaction in a compact, easy-to-use setup. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
